1. What evidence is there to justify the fact that there is a mobile money boom in Somalia? (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown: 1. **Approximately 155 million transactions, worth $2.7 billion or 36% of GDP, are recorded every month, and seven out of every ten Somalis use mobile money services regularly** — mobile money has even superseded the use of cash in the domestic economy.

2. Give reasons why an increase in the adoption of mobile money as an economic mode of transaction among people in Somalia is a major cause for concern. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown: 2. **The mass adoption of mobile money raises concerns about the magnitude of the system's vulnerabilities and its potential macroeconomic effects in case of disruptions**, since customers have no guarantee that their e-money can be redeemed for cash, and know-your-customer data used to identify clients and detect illegal intentions is not systematically registered for mobile money wallets.

3. What major problem do the Somali authorities find in trying to introduce mobile money regulations? (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown: 3. **The main challenge for policymakers and regulators is how to introduce regulations on a mobile money market that has, until now, operated entirely without any regulatory or supervisory oversight**, without disrupting the service that millions of Somalis already rely on daily.

The passage describes the rapid growth of mobile money in Somalia, the regulatory risks this growth raises for consumers, and the phased-in approach recommended to regulate the sector while preserving its benefits for financial inclusion.

4. According to the text, what four measures must the government implement in order to ensure the safe use of mobile money transactions? (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown: 4. **(1)** Safeguard consumer funds and ensure continued, undisrupted service delivery. **(2)** Strengthen service delivery through greater innovation, including stronger agent networks and internal controls, while holding providers responsible for their agents. **(3)** Strengthen consumer protections, including data privacy, and create platforms for complaints and access to redress mechanisms. **(4)** Require clear, consistent and effective reporting and disclosure from providers.

5. Why, in your opinion, do most people prefer using mobile money in business transactions? (1 mark)
questions.corrige_markdown: 5. **Réponse personnelle**, par exemple : parce que le mobile money est plus rapide, plus accessible (il ne nécessite pas de compte bancaire classique ni de déplacement physique jusqu'à une agence), et permet d'effectuer des transferts d'argent instantanés même dans des zones où l'infrastructure bancaire traditionnelle reste limitée.

6. Suggest a possible title for this passage. (1 mark)
questions.corrige_markdown: 6. **"Mobile Money in Somalia: Growth, Risks and the Road to Regulation"** (ou tout titre équivalent résumant la croissance du mobile money, ses risques et le besoin de régulation).
